column1: # SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA - invented products and reviews written to exercise the tool. Not real customer reviews.

column5: review
The suction doesn't hold on our highchair tray at all. My son pulls it right off in two seconds and throws it.
Cute colours and the sections are a good size for little portions. Goes in the dishwasher fine.
Works on our smooth table but won't stick to the textured tray on our Stokke. I wish they made a version that works on textured trays.
Found black spots of mould under the suction base after a month. Water gets trapped inside and you can't get in there to clean it.
Only complaint is the tomato sauce stained the light grey silicone orange.
Stained after the first spaghetti night and now it smells like dish soap. Not worth the price.
Adorable and gender neutral. Suction is strong on our kitchen table.
The suction is so strong I can't get it off the table without spilling everything. Would be nice if it had a release tab.
Attracts lint and hair like crazy and has a greasy film even after washing.
Mold again inside the rim. Should have a design you can fully take apart.
Food slides off the edge because the walls are too shallow for scooping. My daughter gets frustrated.
Nice plate for the price. Suction pulled off once or twice but mostly fine.
The bowl tips over constantly when my toddler leans on the rim. Suction doesn't stick to our tray.
Deep enough for oatmeal and the lid fits well. I wish the lid was leakproof for the diaper bag.
Cracked after a few months in the dishwasher. Cheaply made.
Too small for a 2 year old after the first year. Barely holds a portion of pasta.
Strong plastic smell out of the box that didn't go away after washing.
Beautiful colours and the curved inside makes scooping easy. Our favourite bowl.
Lid doesn't stay on and the bowl leaks in the bag. Would love a version with a locking lid.
Suction stopped working after the first few weeks. Only sticks to glass.
Warped in the microwave on reheat. Says microwave safe on the box.
Spills everywhere because it's so light. Needs a heavier base.
Cute and gender neutral. Stained by carrot puree but otherwise fine.
Leaks from the valve whenever it tips over. My son just shakes it out onto the floor.
Hard to clean the valve and water gets trapped inside the handles. Found mould after two weeks.
Mold in the valve that you can't reach. Unsafe for a baby. Please make the valve removable.
Easy for small hands to hold with the two handles. Pretty colours.
My teething daughter chewed through the spout in a week and a piece came off. Worried about choking.
Good cup. Only downside is the handles are too thick for my 1 year old to grip.
Knocked over all the time and spills from the open top. Needs a weighted base.
The print rubbed off after a few months of washing and the colour looks dull after the dishwasher.
The valve is too hard to suck so she gave up. I wish there were different flow levels.
Black gunk inside the handle again. This design traps water and can't be cleaned.
Better than most cups we tried but still leaks a bit when dropped.
Spoon bowl is too shallow and food falls off before it reaches the mouth. Hard for him to scoop.
Chunky handles are easy to grip for a toddler. Would be nice if they came with a travel case.
The fork snapped at the neck after a month. Sharp edge left behind. Dangerous.
The spoon goes too far in and she gagged. Needs a guard so it can't go too deep.
The silicone handle is slippery when wet and the spoon rolls off the table.
Great first spoons and cute colours. Soft on gums.
Bite marks all over the tip after teething and a bit came off. Not worth the money.
Handle too long for a 1 year old so she can't hold it right. I wish they made a shorter one.
Stained yellow from curry and turmeric and now it looks dirty.
Good spoons. Only issue is they don't stack in the drawer.
